Application's sign-in rules read Authentication's ACR and AMR helpers and the trusted-device AMR value from its use cases. Authentication owns these rules, so it publishes the judgments as public operations (D1, D3) in wi-87746.

Application validates claim release rules and resolves tenant attribute definitions through ClaimMapping's use cases and schema repository. ClaimMapping owns claim release, so it publishes issuance and rule validation as public operations without exposing the repository (D1, D3) in wi-35767.

Application's admin handlers create and update OAuth2 clients and manage their secrets through OAuth2's client use cases. OAuth2 keeps the client invariants and publishes the administration operations (D2, D3) in wi-13438.

Authentication's account handler reads the upcoming MFA enforcement date from Application's use cases. Application owns sign-in policy, so it publishes the evaluation as a public operation (D1, D3) in wi-28791.

Authentication reads the account profile through IdManagement's use cases and saves the user inside the password-change transaction through IdManagement's PostgreSQL adapter. IdManagement publishes the profile query and a transaction-bound user writer (D2, D7) in wi-93579.

Authentication's account portal lists and revokes consents through OAuth2's consent use cases, and logout revokes tokens by session through OAuth2's token use cases. OAuth2 publishes the consent operations, and Authentication defines a revocation port that the composition point binds to OAuth2 (D3, D4) in wi-13438.
DataKeys enqueues re-encryption jobs through Jobs' use cases. Jobs publishes enqueueing as a port and keeps deduplication and retry rules private (D3, D4) in wi-60465.

IdGovernance saves users inside its lifecycle transaction through IdManagement's PostgreSQL and in-memory adapters. IdManagement publishes a transaction-bound user writer so the lifecycle step and the user commit together (D2, D7) in wi-93579.
IdGovernance enqueues lifecycle jobs through Jobs' use cases. Jobs publishes enqueueing as a port (D3, D4) in wi-60465.

IdManagement validates passwords against the tenant policy, checks step-up, resolves sessions, and revokes trusted devices through Authentication's use cases. Authentication owns these rules and publishes the judgments and operations without its stores (D1, D3) in wi-87746.
IdManagement enqueues group reconciliation and user jobs through Jobs' use cases. Jobs publishes enqueueing as a port (D3, D4) in wi-60465.
IdManagement's admin handlers list a user's consents through OAuth2's consent use cases. OAuth2 publishes the consent query (D3) in wi-13438.
OAuth2's authorization handlers evaluate the application sign-in policy through Application's use cases. Application publishes the evaluation and its result type (D1, D3) in wi-28791.

OAuth2's authorization handlers orchestrate login, password expiry, MFA enrollment, TOTP, WebAuthn, recovery codes, and trusted devices by calling nine Authentication packages directly. Authentication owns these steps, so their implementation moves into Authentication and OAuth2 only resumes the authorization request (D1, D8) in wi-93464.
OAuth2 issues ID token claims and resolves attribute definitions through ClaimMapping's use cases. ClaimMapping publishes issuance with its release floor as public operations (D1, D3) in wi-35767.
OAuth2 registers job handlers and enqueues delivery jobs through Jobs' use cases. Jobs publishes enqueueing and handler registration as ports (D3, D4) in wi-60465.
Provisioning registers job handlers and enqueues provisioning jobs through Jobs' use cases. Jobs publishes enqueueing and handler registration as ports (D3, D4) in wi-60465.
SAML's sign-in handler resolves the login session through Authentication's session use cases. Authentication publishes session resolution without exposing session issuance (D1, D3) in wi-87746.
SAML issues assertion attributes through ClaimMapping's use cases and schema repository. ClaimMapping publishes issuance with its release floor as public operations (D1, D3) in wi-35767.

SAML builds and signs assertions with WsFederation's tokens_saml package. wi-90942 decides whether the builder becomes a WsFederation public package or splits into a protocol-neutral shared library (D3, D5, D8).

Tenancy's settings handler validates password policy bounds with constants from Authentication's password use cases. Authentication publishes the policy bounds (D1, D3) in wi-87746; the Tenancy -> Authentication direction itself is decided in wi-21934.
Tenancy's handler dependencies carry the SAML signer type from WsFederation's tokens_saml package. wi-90942 removes the type from Tenancy or replaces it with a published one (D3, D5).
WS-Federation's sign-in handler resolves the login session through Authentication's session use cases. Authentication publishes session resolution (D1, D3) in wi-87746.

WS-Federation and its tokens_saml builder issue claims through ClaimMapping's use cases and schema repository. ClaimMapping publishes issuance with its release floor as public operations (D1, D3) in wi-35767.
The tokens_jose shared library issues ID token claims through ClaimMapping. The signer builds OAuth2 tokens and needs module types, so it moves into OAuth2 (D5, D8) in wi-91505.

tokens_jose reads IdManagement's user type to build tokens, and fixtures_postgres seeds users and groups through IdManagement's adapters. The signer moves into OAuth2 in wi-91505, and the test-only fixtures move out of the shared library in wi-26617 (D5).
metrics_prometheus names Jobs' domain types in its job metrics. The meaning of job kinds belongs to Jobs, so the metrics take shared values that Jobs provides (D5, D6) in wi-26617.

tokens_jose builds OAuth2 tokens with OAuth2's types and ports, fixtures_postgres seeds OAuth2 clients, and sinks_console names an OAuth2 port type. The signer moves into OAuth2 in wi-91505; the fixtures and the console sink stop naming module types in wi-26617 (D5, D6).

tokens_jose selects signing keys through SigningKeys' types and ports, and fixtures_postgres seeds signing keys. The signer moves into OAuth2 in wi-91505 and the fixtures move out of the shared library in wi-26617 (D5).

support_http resolves the tenant, ratelimit/db_postgres, salts_memory, and salts_postgres read the tenant ID through Tenancy's ports, db_memory names Tenancy's type, tokens_jose reads the tenant, and fixtures_postgres seeds tenants. The storage and salt libraries need only the tenant ID string and the middleware belongs to Tenancy (D1, D5) in wi-73604; tokens_jose and the fixtures leave the shared library in wi-91505 and wi-26617.

Application links an OAuth2 client record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). OAuth2 publishes a write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

Application links a SAML service provider record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). SAML publishes a write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

Application links a WS-Federation relying party record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). WS-Federation publishes a write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

IdManagement records the CSV import audit event in the same transaction that commits the user or group import, so a committed import cannot lack its audit record (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). Audit publishes a record write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

IdManagement writes the password history of a password set by user CSV import in the same transaction that commits the imported user, so reuse checks cannot miss an imported password (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). Authentication publishes a history write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

IdManagement enqueues the group reconcile job in the same transaction that commits the group CSV import, so a committed import cannot lack its reconciliation (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). Jobs publishes an enqueue that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.
